description: React component for a comparison page that allows users to select roles and visualizes competency overlaps, gaps, and recommends learning resources. It fetches data from a database and external APIs, performs gap analysis, and presents the information in a tabular format.

classes.name: StatusPill
classes.description: React functional component that displays a visual indicator (pill) for competency status: 'Good', 'Minor Gap', or 'Gap'.

methods.name: difficultyScore
methods.description: Converts difficulty string to a numeric score for ranking learning items.

methods.name: fmtLevel
methods.description: Formats a proficiency level number into a string label (e.g., F, P, A, Au).

methods.name: competencyNameForId
methods.description: Retrieves the competency name for a given competency ID from a list of competencies.
